source: Game table ItemInherentSkills: one row per base item with the skills it grants and a NoReservation flag. The bases below are the rows with the flag set.

The granted skill is an ordinary Spirit skill (30 Spirit from a Lament Amulet, 60 from a Portent Amulet, 100 from an Absent Amulet) whose reservation the item waives. Reported in play: https://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/3975864
_meta.notes: The data adapter does not read ItemInherentSkills yet. Once it does, generate this list from the table and remove this file.
_meta.audit: On a data version change, compare with the bases whose ItemInherentSkills row has NoReservation (the pinned PoB2 exports the same flag as grantedSkillsHaveNoReservation).
